LINE Remove shipping cleats: located on bottom of cabinet. Install four (4) provided leg levelers to bottom of cabinet and level cabinet. The power is controlled by a switch located on the back of the cabinet in the top right hand corner. Plug into A.C. only, 115 volts, 60 cycles.

A line voltage safety, switch has been provided for your protection. It is located on the right rear side of the cabinet. When the back door is removed, it opens the circuit to the line voltage. To restore power (when servicing) pull switch fully out.
